_doc: Hermits and Sages' Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py, merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:hermits-sages. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/people/hermits-sages.items.json.

Where All Waters Return.rule: Vase of the Abyss: once per fight, the first hit that leaves you at or below two-thirds health is poured into the vase instead (refunded in full); when you fall to half health or below, the vase spills 4 Ice and 4 Fire stacks onto the foe. At a Hóa Thần tribulation, the vase takes the lethal blow for its holder once.
Where All Waters Return.approx: Engine was_hit fires after damage, so the poured hit is gated on hp_share <= 0.67 and refunded with heal (of: amount, ignore_taken); 'around you / every foe near you' becomes 4 Ice + 4 Fire stacks on the single foe in 1v1.

A Crane Crosses from the East.rule: Lone Crane: in a hand with a Wind root, each attack you evade sends one afterimage sword cut (0.7 c Physical) back at the attacker, at most once a second. In any other hand the blade sleeps.
A Crane Crosses from the East.approx: Effects have no own.root.<el> readable, so 'a hand with a Wind root' is gated on having fired a wind-tagged art (own.fired_within.60.tag.wind >= 1); sleeps as intended in Tư Không Hạc Niên's pure Metal hand until awakened by The Crane Wakes.

The Blue Sea Becomes Mulberry Fields.rule: Mirror of Seas and Fields: once per fight, the first Thunder strike that lands on you pours into the mirror instead (refunded in full) and raises a stance ward (8 % of max health). Out of combat, still-water scrying is Event Engine content.
The Blue Sea Becomes Mulberry Fields.approx: was_hit refunds event.amount via heal (ignore_taken) and grows a 8 % HP stance ward (ward_grow only scales by hp/peak, not event.amount); out-of-combat still-water scene is outside combat.

records.id: eff:The Blue Sea Becomes Mulberry Fields

The Unspent Bolt.rule: North-Wind Breath: your critical strikes leave a Frozen Lightning stack (1 Ice + 1 Thunder stack for 8 s); at 5 stacks the foe takes a frozen bolt (1.2 c Lightning + 1.2 c Cold) and 5 Ice and 5 Thunder stacks clear.
The Unspent Bolt.approx: Dual Frozen Lightning stack modelled as 1 Ice + 1 Thunder debuff stack plus frozen_bolt counter; unsealing the cave A-1 tribulation bolt is a one-time world event rather than a per-fight trigger.

Purple Smoke on the Burner.rule: Purple Smoke Furnace: out-of-fight craft edge (+1 pill grade, pill toxicity đan độc halved) and the sealed abode A-2 second pill decision.
Purple Smoke on the Burner.not_run: out-of-fight alchemy crafting and abode A-2 story event only; no combat rule.

Noon on One Side.rule: Blazing Sun Fan: each sweep of the fan (fan-tagged art or Fan Gust) lays 2 Fire stacks (6 s) on the foe and cleanses 1 Ice stack from you; when the foe holds 5 or more Fire stacks, your next sweep turns them into a burst (0.25 c Fire per stack) and once a fight melts frost resistance (Sundered 4 s + 0.4 c shield-passing Fire burst).
Noon on One Side.approx: Frost-ward melting is expressed once per fight as Sundered (4 s) + 0.4 c shield-passing Fire burst because no engine action removes foe ward shields directly; 'foes in front of you' narrowed to 1v1.

The Falling Plum Tune.rule: Plum of the Fifth Month: playing a song or sword art opens a 4 s tune (cooldown 6 s) that slows the foe's arts (2 Slowed Time stacks for 4 s); while the tune holds, sword hits deal an extra 0.45 c Soul strike.
The Falling Plum Tune.approx: 10 % slow for 4 s uses Slowed Time (2 stacks = 12 % slow for 4 s); sword hits during the tune fire a 0.45 c Soul follow-up because an art cannot rewrite its dtype mid-fight.

The World Before.rule: What the Old Man Kept, full set (2 pieces): when the Vase of the Abyss spills, the foe's clock stops for 2 s while yours runs, and each art you fire in those 2 s lays 1 stack (6 s) of every element you own (Fire, Water, Earth, Metal, Wood, Ice, Light) on the foe.
The World Before.approx: Effects cannot read own.purity.<el>, so Mạc Quy Khư's seven stack-bearing elements (Fire, Water, Earth, Metal, Wood, Ice, Light) are listed explicitly.

The Crane Wakes.rule: The Lone Crane's Things, full set (3 pieces): while all three are worn, Lone Crane's sleeping rule wakes in any hand; each crit you land sends one afterimage sword cut (0.7 c Physical), at most once a second.

Hears and Answers.rule: The Still Pool, full set (3 pieces): the first attack aimed at you in a fight is avoided with 1 decoy and answered with a Cold tide palm (0.9 c Cold) that lays 2 Water stacks (8 s). Each Thunder strike you take restores 3 % of your max linh lực.
Hears and Answers.approx: First-art evasion uses 1 decoy granted at fight_start and triggers on decoy_struck; Thunder linh lực restore guards on event.amount > 0.
